description: This file defines models, methods, and SQL views for an auction management module in an OpenERP/Odoo system, including classes for auction dates, lots, artists, deposits, categories, bids, and various reporting views.

classes.name: auction.artists
classes.description: Model for auction artists and authors

classes.name: auction.dates
classes.description: Model for auction dates and related operations

classes.name: auction.deposit
classes.description: Model for deposit border objects

classes.name: auction.deposit.cost
classes.description: Model for specific deposit costs

classes.name: auction.lot.category
classes.description: Model for auction lot categories

classes.name: auction.lots
classes.description: Model for auction lots, including pricing, margins, and related calculations

classes.name: auction.bid
classes.description: Model for auction bids

classes.name: auction.lot.history
classes.description: Model for auction lot history

classes.name: auction.bid_line
classes.description: Model for bid lines within an auction bid

classes.name: report.buyer.auction
classes.description: SQL view report for buyer auction summary

classes.name: report.buyer.auction2
classes.description: SQL view report for detailed buyer auction metrics

classes.name: report.seller.auction
classes.description: SQL view report for seller auction summary

classes.name: report.seller.auction2
classes.description: SQL view report for detailed seller auction metrics

classes.name: report.auction.view2
classes.description: SQL view for auction overall metrics

classes.name: report.auction.view
classes.description: SQL view for auction summary

classes.name: report.auction.object.date
classes.description: SQL view for objects per day

classes.name: report.auction.estimation.adj.category
classes.description: SQL view for estimate vs adjudication comparison

classes.name: report.auction.adjudication
classes.description: SQL view for total adjudication per auction

classes.name: report.attendance
classes.description: SQL view for employee sign-in/out attendance

classes.name: report.deposit.border
classes.description: SQL view for deposit border report

classes.name: report.object.encoded
classes.description: SQL view for encoded objects report

classes.name: report.object.encoded.manager
classes.description: SQL view for managed encoded objects report

classes.name: report.unclassified.objects
classes.description: SQL view for unclassified objects report

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes an auction date, creates invoices for buyers and sellers, and updates state to 'closed'.

methods.name: partner_id_change
methods.description: Handles change in partner ID, updates contact info.

methods.name: lots_invoice
methods.description: Creates invoices for selected lots to buyers.

methods.name: compute_buyer_costs
methods.description: Calculates total buyer costs including taxes.

methods.name: compute_seller_costs
methods.description: Calculates total seller costs including taxes and specific costs.

methods.name: buyer_proforma
methods.description: Creates buyer proforma invoices for lots.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches lots by name or catalog number.

methods.name: _sum_taxes_by_type_and_id
methods.description: Sums taxes by type and ID.

methods.name: numerotate
methods.description: Assigns sequential catalog numbers to lots.
